Y U K O N I N A L L I T S F O R M S .
Precision means many things. One of them is having the right amount of room to fit your life. So, we’ve designed Yukon and Yukon XL to do just that. Both models offer the option of
seating for up to nine. Need extra space? Choose Yukon XL and gain additional cargo room behind the first, second and third rows. Your second- and third-row passengers will also
benefit from the comfort of generous leg room. Yukon is available in Denali, SLT and SLE trim levels so you can tailor the amenities to suit your style.
